name: SPY 6-Month Return After First Fed Rate Cut of Each Easing Cycle
description: Detects Fed easing cycle starts (first rate cut after >= 252 trading day gap) using stitched DFEDTARU+DFEDTAR, then measures SPY 126-day forward return. Fully dynamic — no hardcoded cycle counts. Uses where() sparse pattern for all outputs.
source:
# ============================================================
# SPY 6-Month Return After First Fed Rate Cut of Each Easing Cycle
# ============================================================
# Fully dynamic — no hardcoded cycle counts or occurrence indices.
# Uses where() sparse pattern: one bar/event per detected cycle.
#
# Methodology:
#   1. Stitch DFEDTARU (2008+) + DFEDTAR (pre-2008) via coalesce + ffill
#   2. Detect rate cuts (daily diff < 0)
#   3. New easing cycle = first cut after >= 252 trading day gap
#   4. Measure SPY forward 126-day (6M) return at each cycle start
#   5. All outputs use where() sparse values — handles ANY number of cycles
#
# Expected cycles in SPY range (2003+): 2007, 2019, 2024, plus any future
# Reference: avg 6M return ~+4% (recession cuts avg -10%, non-recession avg +15%)
# ============================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
ts = index().value

# Fed funds target rate: coalesce BEFORE ffill
dfedtaru = economic_indicators(series_id="DFEDTARU")
dfedtar = economic_indicators(series_id="DFEDTAR")
fed_rate = ffill(coalesce(dfedtaru.result, dfedtar.result))

# --- Cycle Detection ---
rate_change = diff(fed_rate, 1)
is_cut = is_valid(rate_change) and rate_change < 0

# Bars since previous cut (shifted 1 bar so current bar doesn't count itself)
# coalesce null (first-ever cut) to 999 to avoid null propagation in the OR chain
bars_gap = coalesce(barssince(is_cut) >> 1, 999)

# New easing cycle = first cut after >= 252 trading day gap (incl. first-ever)
is_cycle_start = is_cut and bars_gap >= 252

# --- Forward Returns ---
fwd_6m = forward_returns(src.c, 126)

# --- Sparse Event Values (dynamic — handles any number of cycles) ---
cycle_return = where(is_cycle_start, fwd_6m)
cycle_rate = where(is_cycle_start, fed_rate)
cycle_cut_bps = where(is_cycle_start, rate_change)
cycle_spy = where(is_cycle_start, src.c)

# Year label for bar chart x-axis
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
cycle_year = where(is_cycle_start, year_num)

# --- Output 1: Context — Fed Rate History ---
xy_lines(
    title="Fed Funds Rate with Easing Cycle Starts",
    y_axis_label="Fed Funds Target Rate",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category="Fed Easing Cycles",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Fed Funds Target", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(ts, fed_rate)

# --- Output 2: Event Map — One Card per Cycle Start ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Easing Cycle Start",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Fed Rate", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rate Cut", dp=0, type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="SPY Price", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title="6M Fwd Return", dp=1, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(cycle_rate, cycle_cut_bps, cycle_spy, cycle_return, is_cycle_start)

# --- Output 3: Punchline — One Bar per Cycle, Color by Sign ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title="SPY 6-Month Return After First Fed Cut",
    y_axis_label="6-Month Forward Return",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category="Fed Easing Cycles",
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=cycle_return, label=cycle_year)
